fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Pack Loose
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 20 damage. When one hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Fetch
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Lurcher at Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded hunting hound fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
